lesson.grammar_point: present simple vs present continuous: the routine of the job and the projects of now

listenings.text: Hi, I'm Oliver. I'm a product designer at a small bank in London, in the mobile app team. My week is quite regular. On Mondays I usually meet the stakeholders and we plan the week. On Tuesdays and Wednesdays I design, and on Thursdays we test with real users. I don't work on Fridays, because I work four days a week. But this month is different. At the moment we're designing a new flow to open an account in five minutes, and the deadline is very close. So these days I'm working on Fridays too, and I'm drinking a lot of coffee.

Hello, I'm Priya, and I'm a product manager at a fintech company in Bangalore. People often ask me what I actually do. Well, I don't design and I don't write code. I work with a designer and a tech lead every day, and together we decide what the team builds first and what waits. I talk to users, I read the data, and I protect the deadline. At the moment we're rolling out a new payment feature. We're giving it to a small group of users first, and we're watching the numbers every morning. If the numbers are good, we open it to everybody next month.
